propositions: prepare_reclaim_backup.py must enumerate live origin heads/tags at runtime without hardcoded counts and collapse annotated-tag ^{} lines while preserving exact direct and peeled OIDs

The helper must create an off-repo backup bundle and JSON manifest with one unique run namespace under refs/reclaim-backup/, verify bundle integrity, and refuse any pre-existing refs/reclaim-backup/ prefix or output paths inside the repository/Git directory/registered worktrees

Every enumerated commit ref must receive exactly one old-tip ancestry relationship (same, ancestor, descendant, diverged, unrelated, or non-commit) and non-commit refs must be recorded without ancestry commands
The helper must refuse partial/promisor clones, missing/non-commit pins, and any pre-existing output artifacts; it must verify bundle restore reproduces the exact old-tip and pin-tip OID map

The helper must perform zero remote writes (no push or delete), leave origin heads/tags byte-identical before and after success, and remove only its run-unique namespace on normal completion or caught failure

Abnormal termination recovery requires discarding the clone and rerunning in a fresh unfiltered clone; A6-1 must recreate the final bundle if the quiet-window old tip differs from the rehearsal old tip
